tvShow.name: Marvel Zombies
tvShow.overview: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a desperate group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking life and limb to save their world.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Lone survivors face an unforgiving world of horrors.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: On the open road, the hunger for flesh rules all.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The rotting dead will taste their fear.
